text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council authorize a speed limit reduction from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Forthbridge Crescent and Chesham Drive, as the warrants are satisfied.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Forthbridge Crescent, between Calvington Drive and Heathrow Drive. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Chesham Drive, between Heathrow Drive and the west end of Chesham Drive.
